native_result.query: What proportion of studies in Experimental Economics were conducted in a lab setting?
native_result.HypoA: In Experimental Economics, all studies (both original and replication) were conducted in a lab setting (100%), while in Psychology, a small proportion of replication studies were also conducted online (8.8%)
native_result.HypoB: In the Experimental Economics replication project (ee subset), 100% of studies (18/18; Wilson 95% CI 82.4%-100%; Clopper-Pearson exact 95% CI 81.5%-100%) were conducted in a lab (in-person) setting: every ee row is coded online.o == 0 with student or community subjects paid cash, and online.r is also 0 in all 18 rows, so the replication side, the both-sides definition and the triple-evidence definition all return the same 18/18. Because online.o and online.r are constant at 0 within ee, the proportion is necessarily a boundary value and is reported unsmoothed; 'lab' is a proxy (online == 0) since the dataset contains no lab boolean field, lab_id is 100% missing in ee, and us_lab.* was verified to be a US-location flag rather than lab evidence. Hence the ee evidence base is purely in-person/university-lab, and its low replication rate cannot be attributed to online-versus-lab data collection; cross-project, original studies are overwhelmingly in-person everywhere (rpp 89/90 = 98.9%, ml1 12/13 = 92.3%, ml3 10/10 = 100%), with projects differing mainly on the replication side (lab-row level ml1 75.0%, ml3 95.2% in-person).
native_result.WorkflowB: 1) Read file1 (927x57; ml1 592/ml3 220/rpp 97/ee 18) and file2 (143x15). 2) Unit = unique id (O/R pair == replicated original study); unit counts for all three candidate units reported explicitly (ee 18/18/18). 3) Headline lab proxy = online.o == 0 with NaN-aware validity masks (missing excluded from denominator); sensitivities S1 = online.o==0 & online.r==0, S2 = + subjects.o in {students,community} & compensation.o in {cash,credit}; plus replication-side online.r==0. 4) Wilson 95% and Clopper-Pearson exact 95% CIs and one-sided exact binomial p vs 0.5 for every definition (boundary value reported, not smoothed). 5) Methodological exclusion of us_lab.* (verified identical to experiment_country=='United States' on all 927 rows, agreement 1.0000, incl. 40/115 online rows) and lab_id (0/18 in ee). 6) Per-study ee audit table (18 rows) with classified_lab_by_H sum check, plus explicit exclusion log (NONE). 7) Cross-project table on file-1 labels only, unique-id dedup, with and without drop==True ids, and U3 quantification at lab-row level plus detection that all 26 aggregated rows of ml1/ml3 misreport online.r. 8) File-2 used only for coverage cross-validation (18/18 heuristic author+year match; 12/18 sample-size disagreements). Script rerun twice with identical md5 for all CSV outputs.

sub_hypo.context: Experimental Economics project; all 18 original/replication study pairs.
